practical_tip: Multiple same-name locations exist across the city with varying reputations and ownership — specify the Chinatown (Archer Ave) location. Cross-check Yelp vs Google before treating 'Michelin-recommended' as a current-day guarantee.

name: World's Largest Starbucks Reserve Roastery
name_zh: 全球最大星巴克旗舰店
address: 646 N Michigan Ave, Chicago, IL 60611
rating_note: Yelp: 2,339 reviews, 10,736 photos — exact star average not surfaced in search results
reservation: Not needed for general access; OpenTable listing exists for certain seated experiences
verdict_reason: Confirmed open at stated address with very high review volume (2,339 on Yelp alone), consistent with continued strong foot traffic since its 2019 opening.
signature: Four-floor all-glass building with visible roasting equipment and a rooftop bar.
why_tiktok: 'World's largest X' framing is a reliable short-video title hook with several distinct camera setups in one location.
practical_tip: Go on a weekday morning to actually get a seat on the upper floors; weekends are standing-room photo traffic only.

name: Art Institute of Chicago
address: 111 S Michigan Ave, Chicago, IL 60603
rating_note: TripAdvisor: 4.8/5, 54,267 reviews — rated the #1 Chicago attraction for four consecutive years, ahead of Millennium Park, Navy Pier, and Wrigley Field
closed_days: Check current museum-day closures (historically closed some Mondays); verify before visiting
reservation: Timed tickets recommended for peak periods, not required
verdict_reason: Highest-rated and best-documented entry in this entire set — real, open, and the hype is fully earned by current review data.
signature: Photograph in front of the Impressionist wing and the two bronze lion statues at the entrance.
why_tiktok: The free lion statues function as a no-ticket-required photo backdrop, separate from visiting the museum itself.
practical_tip: The bronze lion statues out front are free to photograph without paying admission — a common quick stop even for travelers skipping the museum itself.

name: Old Joliet Prison (abandoned/haunted)
name_zh: 网红监狱 / 越狱拍摄地
address: 1125 Collins St, Joliet, IL 60432
rating_note: Not independently found on Yelp/Google in this pass; site's own visitor info confirms operating status
closed_days: Open daily 10am-4pm for general/self-guided access; guided walking tours are seasonal, April-October only
reservation: Self-guided access walk-in; guided tours (incl. movie/Prison Break-themed tours) require advance booking
price_band: Free (self-guided exterior/grounds); guided tours ticketed separately
verdict_reason: Real and open, and the Prison Break filming-location claim checks out, but access is materially more limited than the TikTok framing implies: guided tours only run April-October, the site is under active construction/preservation with buildings rotating in and out of accessibility, tours are outdoors rain-or-shine, and it is not ADA-approved (only ~70% accessible). A traveler expecting a full indoor cellblock walk-through in winter will be disappointed.
signature: Walk the abandoned cellblocks used as the filming location for the TV show Prison Break.
why_tiktok: Framed in Chinese travel content as a 小众玩法 (off-the-beaten-path activity) distinct from the standard skyline/food circuit.
practical_tip: Requires a car and ~1.5hr round trip from downtown. Guided tours (including the Prison Break-themed ones) run April-October only — outside that window you're limited to self-guided grounds access, and even then some buildings may be roped off for preservation work.

name: Chicago-style Hot Dog (Portillo's)
address: 100 W Ontario St, Chicago, IL 60654 (River North location)
rating_note: Yelp River North location: 2.8 stars, 973 reviews — a notably mediocre rating for a business this hyped
reservation: Not needed, but expect long lines at lunch/dinner, especially downtown
verdict_reason: The dish and the 'no ketchup' rule are real and worth featuring, but Portillo's River North specifically pulls only 2.8/5 on Yelp with nearly 1,000 reviews — a clear signal that reviewer experience (long waits, tourist-trap crowding, inconsistent quality at the high-volume downtown locations) meaningfully undercuts the viral reputation. This is the single biggest rating-vs-hype gap found in this sweep.
signature: The all-beef dog dragged through the garden — mustard, relish, onion, tomato, pickle spear, sport peppers, celery salt, NO ketchup.
why_tiktok: The 'no ketchup' rule is a built-in controversy/education hook that short-form food content loves.
practical_tip: 2.8/5 Yelp at River North reflects real complaints about lines and crowding at the flagship downtown location — order ahead via the app, or consider a less-mobbed Portillo's location outside the Loop for a better experience of the same food.

name: Zmzm Sweets
address: 10511 S Harlem Ave, Chicago Ridge, IL 60415
verdict_reason: Confirmed open and operating; multiple current listings (Yelp, Grubhub, DoorDash, official site) show active hours. Real Middle Eastern dessert shop, not a fabricated TikTok claim.
rating_note: Yelp/aggregate ~3.9-4.0 stars across ~1,600+ cross-platform reviews (exact current Yelp count not independently pulled due to 403 block, but multiple secondary sources converge on ~4.0)
closed_days: none listed — open daily, hours vary Mon-Thu 10am-12am, Fri-Sat 10am-1am, Sun 10am-12am
signature: 3D fruit-shaped pastries ($9.99 each) — mango, strawberry, lemon, passionfruit, dragon fruit; also knafa
why_tiktok: Novelty of biting into a hyper-realistic fruit-shaped pastry to reveal cream/filling inside is a natural short-form reveal format
practical_tip: New/small shop in Chicago Ridge, not downtown — factor in drive time (roughly 30-40 min from the Loop). Reviews note flavors are hit-or-miss, so treat as a novelty experience rather than guaranteed best-in-class pastry.

name: Cafe Deko
neighborhood: Printers Row / South Loop (also Lakeview location at 800 W Diversey Pkwy)
address: 715 S Dearborn St, Chicago, IL 60605 (Printers Row); 800 W Diversey Pkwy (Lakeview)
verdict_reason: Confirmed open — Printers Row location opened April 2, 2025 in the historic Donohue Building; Lakeview original location also still active. Real, photogenic, matches the TikTok claim.
rating_note: Printers Row location: newer listing showing 5.0 stars on a small sample (~16 reviews) plus a separately-cited 4.4 aggregate (~380 reviews) across platforms; Lakeview location has its own separate Yelp page (176 reviews)
closed_days: check hours — Printers Row open daily from 7am per one source
signature: 1920s-30s Art Deco interior — order the freddo cappuccino and shoot photos among the velvet chairs and gold detailing
why_tiktok: Extremely photogenic 'stepped into a painting' interior is tailor-made for aesthetic walk-through and outfit-check videos
practical_tip: Two separate Chicago locations exist (Printers Row and Lakeview) — confirm which one before you go, they have different addresses and different Yelp pages. Go for the visuals more than a must-order drink; can get crowded with people filming, so weekday mornings are calmer.

name: Goddess and the Baker
neighborhood: Multiple Chicago locations (33 S Wabash flagship near Millennium Park) + Brookfield, WI
address: 33 S Wabash Ave, Chicago, IL 60603
verdict_reason: Long-running, confirmed-open Chicago fast-casual chain; the rainbow cake is a real, standing signature item, not a fabricated trend.
rating_note: Google ~4.3; Tripadvisor ~4/5 (#83 of 5,231 Chicago restaurants, 508 reviews); Yelp listing shows 1,799 reviews (exact star figure not independently confirmed, blocked by 403)
signature: Famous Rainbow Cake slice
why_tiktok: Bright, color-blocked cake reads well on video; brand runs its own TikTok account amplifying the item
practical_tip: Long-running signature item (not a brand-new flash-in-the-pan trend) — reliable order, available seasonally/by the slice.

name: Honeybear Cafe
address: 7036 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60626
verdict_reason: Confirmed open, actively operating, strong and consistent review volume across platforms; the French toast flight is real and central to the menu.
rating_note: Yelp: 932 reviews (star figure not independently pulled, blocked); Restaurant Guru shows ~4.9/5 across 3,928 reviews — hype holds up
reservation: reservations accepted (not required, but recommended for weekend mornings)
signature: French Toast Flight / Trio (cookie butter + banana, strawberry field, Rogers Park extreme) — order the Brown Butter Latte alongside
why_tiktok: Flight format (three mini French toasts) is a shareable, visually varied single-table shot that performs well as a brunch video
practical_tip: BYOB, real hype backed by very strong ratings — expect a wait on weekends despite reservations being accepted; go early (opens 7:30am).

name: Ume Tea
address: 2002 S Wentworth Ave, Suite 101, Chicago, IL 60616
verdict_reason: The Chinatown location is confirmed open and active. However, the Loop location the candidate also cited (79 E Jackson Blvd) appears in Yelp under a separate listing marked CLOSED (35 reviews) — the two addresses should not be treated interchangeably.
rating_note: Chinatown Yelp listing: 379 photos, 187 reviews (exact star rating not independently confirmed, blocked by 403)
signature: Surprise mystery plushie boba cup (~$12+) with any drink of choice
why_tiktok: Unboxing format — the reveal of which plushie you got at the bottom of the cup is a built-in TikTok hook
practical_tip: Go to the Chinatown location (2002 S Wentworth Ave) — a separate downtown Loop location referenced in older posts (79 E Jackson) has a Yelp listing showing as closed, so confirm before making that your destination. Mixed reviews on tea strength/quality — go for the novelty/gift factor, not necessarily best boba in the city.

name: La Boulangerie & Co
address: 3129 W Logan Blvd, Chicago, IL 60647
verdict_reason: Real, currently operating bakery with the crookie as an actual menu item — but do not confuse it with the unrelated original 'La Boulangerie' at 2569 N Milwaukee Ave, which closed permanently back in 2013. Rating is decent but not exceptional.
rating_note: Yelp: 3.9 stars, 155 reviews (borderline — under the 4.0 hype-holds-up bar); a Chamber of Commerce aggregator separately shows 4.5/474, so treat with some caution pending a direct Yelp confirmation
signature: "Crookie" — the viral cookie croissant / croissant roll
why_tiktok: Rode the international croissant-hybrid trend wave (cookie x croissant), a format that had already gone viral out of Paris/Christkindlmarket
practical_tip: Confirm you're headed to 3129 W Logan Blvd — an entirely different, permanently-closed 'La Boulangerie' once existed at 2569 N Milwaukee Ave and still shows up in some searches. Sells out — items are baked in batches, go earlier in the day rather than afternoon.

name: Fat Peach Bakery
address: 2907 S Archer Ave, Chicago, IL 60608
verdict_reason: Confirmed open, small-batch bakery with the strawberry milk croissant as an actual, currently-sold item.

closed_days: CORRECTION — closed Mon-Wed, open Thu-Sun only (candidate said Fri-Sun, which understates the schedule by one day)
signature: Strawberry milk croissant
why_tiktok: Part of the stuffed/flavored croissant wave; limited hours + small batches create genuine scarcity that drives content ('sell out' urgency)
practical_tip: Open Thursday-Sunday, 9am-2pm (not just Fri-Sun as some posts suggest) — line forms 30+ min before opening, items sell out fast, arrive early.

name: Daeji Dough Company
address: 1360 W Belmont Ave, Chicago, IL 60657
verdict_reason: Confirmed open, real Korean-fusion bakery; the tteokbokki croissant is an actual current menu item corroborated by press (Axios, WTTW) independent of TikTok.

closed_days: check hours — items typically sell out by 11am
signature: Tteokbokki croissant — seaweed croissant filled with Korean rice cake (chewy-crunchy)
why_tiktok: Unexpected savory-Korean/French pastry mashup is inherently video-bait; picked up local press (WTTW, Axios) alongside organic creator coverage shortly after opening
practical_tip: Newly opened (fall 2025) — expect lines as buzz is still fresh and items sell out by ~11am; also worth trying the bulgogi-mushroom focaccia.

name: Soft Bites
address: 705 W Belden Ave, Chicago, IL
verdict_reason: Status is genuinely ambiguous: Yelp explicitly lists this address under the name 'Souffle Bites' as CLOSED (updated as recently as July 2026), while delivery platforms (Grubhub, Seamless, DoorDash) currently list an active 'Soft Bites' at the exact same address with live hours (11am-3:10pm). This looks like a name change (Souffle Bites → Soft Bites) that Yelp hasn't reconciled, but it could also mean the concept closed and a listing is stale — cannot confirm which with certainty.
rating_note: Old 'Souffle Bites' Yelp listing: 39 reviews, marked closed — not a reliable current rating
closed_days: check hours — call ahead given the conflicting closure signal
signature: Jiggly Japanese soufflé pancakes (Matcha, Strawberry & Custard, Nutella, Taro)
why_tiktok: Jiggle/wobble texture on camera is a proven soufflé-pancake TikTok format that travels well across cities
practical_tip: Call or check delivery-app hours before making a special trip — Yelp shows this spot (under its earlier name 'Souffle Bites') as permanently closed while Grubhub/DoorDash still show it active at the same 705 W Belden Ave address. This kind of small dessert shop is exactly the profile that can close on short notice.

name: Matcha Cita
address: Fulton Market, Chicago, IL (exact street address not independently confirmed — verify via matchacitachi.com/fulton-market before visiting)
verdict_reason: Confirmed open, real matcha cafe with a permanent Fulton Market shop (grew from a Lincoln Park pop-up); rating is solid and consistent with the moderate-hype framing.
rating_note: 4.0 stars, 460 reviews (confirmed)
signature: Matcha flight (multiple flavors incl. Strawberry and Banana Cream matcha)
why_tiktok: Rode the broader matcha-cafe TikTok wave; brand runs its own account (@matchacitachi) actively posting drink content, plus the flight format is inherently video-friendly (several drinks in one shot)
practical_tip: Reviews flag it as a bit pricey and inconsistent (one review noted matcha got 'gritty and chunky') — the flight is the better value/photo option than a single drink; rating (4.0/460) confirms solid-not-spectacular, matching the moderate hype level.

name: Do-Rite Donuts
neighborhood: Multiple Chicago locations (West Loop flagship, Erie St, Wacker Dr, Wrigleyville, Streeterville)
address: multiple — e.g. 233 E Erie St, Chicago, IL 60611
verdict_reason: Confirmed open across multiple locations with very strong, consistent ratings — the hype clearly holds up despite the candidate's own 'weak' TikTok evidence strength rating.
rating_note: Erie St location: 4.6 stars, 3,669 reviews; Streeterville: 4.7/266; Willis Tower (Tripadvisor): 4.8/5
closed_days: none — multiple locations, check specific hours
signature: Seasonal specialty donuts — pistachio and pumpkin variants called out specifically
why_tiktok: Long-running Chicago donut favorite that keeps recirculating in 'best Chicago donuts' TikTok roundups rather than one single viral moment
practical_tip: Ratings are excellent (4.6-4.8 across locations) despite the TikTok evidence being thin — this is a reliable local favorite that over-delivers relative to its viral footprint. Go for classic flavors, and note the fried chicken sandwich-on-a-donut is now also a draw.

rating_note: not found — no venue-level rating exists since this isn't a sit-down location
closed_days: check Gangnam Market's own hours, not a separate schedule
signature: Crunchy freeze-dried-style ice cream bites made with real fruit
why_tiktok: Novel packaged snack format plus creator-hosted meet-and-greet giveaways at the market drove direct TikTok promotion
practical_tip: This is a grab-and-go packaged snack inside a grocery store (Gangnam Market), not a sit-down dessert destination — good add-on stop if you're already there for other Korean grocery/food items, not worth a dedicated trip on its own.
